FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course this Skilland activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Activity name

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: General introduction of the Skilland activity

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the intro field (MOODLE, HTML, MARKDOWN, etc.)

FIELD.NAME: skilland_topicid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the topic in Skilland represented by this activity

FIELD.NAME: snapshotid
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot identifier from Skilland for the last published version

FIELD.NAME: snapshotcreatedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time when the current snapshot was created in Skilland

FIELD.NAME: lastsynced
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time when SCORM activities were last synced from Skilland

FIELD.NAME: autoupdate
FIELD.COMMENT: If 1, automatically update SCORM activities when a new snapshot is published

FIELD.NAME: lockafterfirstaccess
FIELD.COMMENT: If 1, prevent updates once students have accessed the content

FIELD.NAME: hidelabels
FIELD.COMMENT: If 1, hide Skilland codes (e.g. T2-L1) from student-facing names

FIELD.NAME: topic_orderindex
FIELD.COMMENT: Position of this topic within the course (1-based) for lesson numbering like L3.1

FIELD.NAME: scormcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course module ID of the topic SCORM package (one per topic)

FIELD.NAME: scorm_provisioned
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when the topic SCORM was provisioned

TABLE.NAME: skilland_course
TABLE.COMMENT: Maps Moodle course to a Skilland course

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle course id

FIELD.NAME: skilland_courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: ID of the Skilland course corresponding to this Moodle course

FIELD.NAME: skilland_orgid
FIELD.COMMENT: Skilland organization ID (for audit/logging)

FIELD.NAME: timesynced
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time when course was last synced with Skilland

TABLE.NAME: skilland_lesson
TABLE.COMMENT: Lessons imported from Skilland for a given activity

FIELD.NAME: skillandid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to skilland.id

FIELD.NAME: skilland_lessonid
FIELD.COMMENT: Lesson ID in Skilland

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Lesson title as imported from Skilland

FIELD.NAME: orderindex
FIELD.COMMENT: Ordering of lessons within the topic

FIELD.NAME: scormcmid
FIELD.COMMENT: DEPRECATED: Legacy per-lesson SCORM cmid. Use skilland.scormcmid for topic SCORM.

FIELD.NAME: scoid
FIELD.COMMENT: Moodle scorm_scoes.id for this lesson's SCO within the topic SCORM package

FIELD.NAME: sco_identifier
FIELD.COMMENT: SCO identifier from the SCORM manifest (matches API mappings.scoId)

FIELD.NAME: snapshotid
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot identifier for this lesson, if provided by Skilland

FIELD.NAME: snapshotcreatedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time when lesson snapshot was created in Skilland

FIELD.NAME: updatedat
FIELD.COMMENT: Last update timestamp from Skilland

FIELD.NAME: visible
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether this lesson is selected for visibility
